yacl3.config.scorchful:common/entity.des: Спеціальні налаштування для сутностей і мобів.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/entity.ena: Вимикає галюцинації під час перегрівання в пустелі, як човни та квіти.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/entity.fea: На скільки помножити дальність виявлення сутностей (включаючи гравців) ворожого моба.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/entity.onF: Коефіцієнт осушення швидкости під час пожежі
З кожним кроком збільшує кількість точок замочування, які видаляються з сутности, яка горить.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/entity.soa: Збільшує кількість очок вимочування, які застосовуються, коли сутність отримує удар будь-яким зіллям бризок.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/entity.tou: Вологість під час дотику до води або дощу збільшується за такт
Скільки точок замочування потрібно додати, коли торкаєтеся води чи дощу за кожну позначку. Зауважте, що занурення у воду повністю замочує вас, незалежно від того, що це встановлено.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/item.enabl: Вимикає ефект водяного дихання з обладунками черепахи.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/item.fireB: Керує тим, який тип вогняної кулі створюється під час кидання вогняного заряду. Маленький схожий на постріл із роздавача та створює вогонь при влучанні. Великий більше схожий на ґаста і створює вибух, а вимкнений вимикає цю функцію.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/item.fireP: Стійкість до тепла протипожежного захисту для кожного рівня
Скільки теплостійкости має давати чари протипожежного захисту для кожного рівня захисту від вогню.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/item.hydra: Збільшує кількість води, що надходить в організм шляхом споживання зволожувальної їжі та напоїв.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/item.impal: Скільки шкоди зачарування протикання повинно завдати водяним сутностя за рівень.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/item.maxRe: Multiplier for the Rehydration drink size that controls the maximum amount of body water provided by a full suit of Rehydration armor.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/item.parch: Multiplies the amount of body water lost from consuming Hydrating food and drink.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/item.refre: Multiplies the amount of body water provided by consuming Refreshing food and drink.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/item.rehyd: The threshold for how much body water needs to be collected before Rehydration will automatically rehydrate the player.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/item.susta: Multiplies the amount of body water provided by consuming Sustaining food and drink.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/item.turtl: Multiplies the Lung Capacity attribute value of Turtle Armor.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/temperatur: Arid biome sweating efficiency multiplier
A multiplier for sweating efficiency when the relative humidity is at or below 20%. This applies to arid climates like Deserts, Badlands, and Savannas, as well as The Nether.
Burning temperature multiplier
Multiplies the temperature point change applied to entities on fire each tick.
Burning temperature multiplier with Fire Resistance
Multiplies the temperature point change applied to entities that are on fire, but also have the Fire Resistance effect, each tick.
Environment Settings
General Settings
Temperature Settings
Temperature Sources
Cooling food temperature multiplier
Multiplies the temperature point change applied to players after eating items with the tag #scorchful:is_cooling_food.
Cooling multiplier
Multiplies the final temperature point change of all non-environment cooling sources like sweating and powder snow.
Degrees per temperature level increase (in °C/°K)
Specifies the number of Celsius/Kelvin degrees the temperature must be above the minimum heat threshold for each one-point increase in player temperature per tick. Must be positive and non-zero.
Settings for the Scorchful temperature system.
Enable environment heating
Global toggle on all heating from the environment.
Environment heating tick interval
How many ticks should occur between applying heat to a player from the environment. Setting this to large values can be used to slow heat down. This may not be set to a value less than 1.
Environment temperature multiplier
Multiplies the final temperature point change of an environment temperature change.
Extra Humid biome sweating efficiency multiplier

A multiplier for sweating efficiency when the relative humidity is at or above 80%. This applies to rainy climates like Jungles, Swamps during the Wet Season (if a seasons mod is installed); to cave biomes; and to all non-arid biomes when it rains.
Fireball temperature multiplier
Multiplies the temperature point change applied to entities when struck by a Fire Charge.
Heating multiplier
Multiplies the final temperature point change of all non-environment heating sources like fire and lava.
Humid biome sweating efficiency multiplier
A multiplier for sweating efficiency when the relative humidity is between 65% and 80^. This applies to rainy climates like Jungles, Swamps, etc.
Ice temperature multiplier
Multiplies the temperature point change applied each tick from entities standing on ice.
In lava warm rate temperature multiplier
Multiplies the temperature point change applied to entities swimming in Lava each tick.
Max environment heating scale
The maximum temperature scale that the environment can heat players to. Given as a percentage from 0 to 1 (0 = 0%, 1 = 100%)
Minimum temperature for heat (in °C)
Cutoff temperature for overheating in Celsius. Biomes at or above this temperature will apply environment heating to players. May not be less than 25°C.
Powder Snow temperature multiplier
Multiplies the temperature point change applied to entities in Powder Snow each tick. This only applies to entities that are currently warm.
Soaked temperature multiplier
Multiplies the temperature point change applied entities that are wet, each tick.
Strider cooling temperature multiplier
Multiplies the cooling to applied only to Striders each tick they are not in Lava.
Sweating efficiency
A multiplier for overall sweating efficiency. Large values mean you will cool down faster from being wet.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/weather.de: Specific settings for Scorchful's weather-related effects.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/weather.do: Enable/disable sand piles accumulating on the ground during sandstorms.
yacl3.config.scorchful:common/weather.sa: Sets the maximum height of sand piles that can accumulate during sand storms. Maximum value is 8.
Sandstorm Follow Range reduction amount (percent from -1 to +1)
How much to multiply the total follow range of entities on the surface by during Sandstorms. Negative values decrease follow range, positive values increase it.
How much to multiply the total speed of entities on the surface by during Sandstorms. Negative values provide slowness, positive values provide speed.
yacl3.config.scorchful:compat/dehydratio: Specific settings for Scorchful's builtin compatibility with the Dehydration mod. This is only relevant if you use Dehydration.
Minimum water level required for sweating
The minimum number of water points needed to be able to sweat (similar to how much hunger you need to heal)
